# Unsloth brand assets

The Unsloth sloth sticker is a third-party brand mark. Unsloth artwork and trademark rights remain with their respective owners. Inclusion does not imply endorsement.

The native color and monochrome SVG implementations are sourced from [LobeHub icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons), revision `8a1b2821bb768c484fe8da20c5e1838b6bf551a9`, under the MIT license reproduced in `LICENSE-lobehub` (Copyright © 2023 LobeHub).

The included official Unsloth PNG, from the [Unsloth repository](https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth), is retained only as a visual fidelity reference. It is not embedded in generated icons and is not covered by the SuperIntelligence MIT license.

`src/logos/unsloth.mjs` retains the native SVG path geometry, source flat colors, even-odd monochrome cutouts and the source monochrome sticker-fold opacity. The original sticker silhouette and sloth facial features are preserved. The shared isometric carrier is original SuperIntelligence artwork.

`sources.json` records pinned source URLs, retrieval date and SHA-256 hashes for each asset.
